title: KTL-001: Reuse-first execution, evidence, and learning loop
description: Executable packaging of the issue #354 meta-analysis and the corrected reuse-first direction. This initiative does not duplicate the two active Builder-verification workers or the active Chat reuse worker. It first proves a cross-tool next/session-end loop, then installs reuse governance, consumes the active workers' evidence, and promotes the surviving Product Evidence, Capability, Product Studio, Agent Canvas, model-bench, and Mission-projection slices. Builder remains the only execution queue; STATE/HANDOFF remain continuity; ~/kb remains cross-tool learning. Every packet has a removable proving slice and must stop rather than create a second authority.

packets.title: Prove the cross-tool next protocol resolves one authorized packet
packets.objective: Independently verify and harden the repo-owned next protocol so a bare 'next' instruction in OpenCode, Claude Code, or Codex performs the cold-start receipt, surveys live parallel work, applies this manifest idempotently, continues existing owned work before starting new work, selects one eligible non-colliding packet, executes through governed Builder rails, and invokes session-end exactly once. Do not add a second queue or infer task identity from prose. Add the smallest deterministic resolver helper only if the skill instructions alone cannot produce repeatable selection from fixture states.
acceptance_criteria: A fixture with one running owned task resolves to continue rather than start a duplicate
A fixture with an unrelated running task and one eligible non-overlapping packet resolves to the eligible packet
A fixture with overlapping allowed paths refuses the new packet and names the collision
A byte-identical initiative apply creates no duplicate packet tasks
OpenCode, Claude Code, and Codex entry instructions all route a bare next instruction to the same canonical skill
One local dry-run transcript reaches a single selected packet and then session-end without beginning a second packet

packets.title: Prove session-end records evidence-based workflow learning
packets.objective: Harden the session-end skill around scripts/session_learning.py. At session end, extract at most three concrete workflow signals with stable keys, evidence, impact, and a suggested change; store them in ~/kb/workflow-signals or the documented repo fallback; promote integrity incidents immediately and ordinary signals only after repetition; surface at most one promoted code improvement in the existing recommendation channel after checking for an existing roadmap, queue, PR, or issue owner. Do not automatically create issues or queue tasks in this packet and do not treat a single annoyance as a durable lesson.
acceptance_criteria: The first non-critical occurrence is recorded as observe rather than promoted
The second occurrence of the same stable key within 30 days is promoted
Fabricated success, queue integrity, paid waste, data-loss risk, and security-boundary signals promote immediately
Corrupt prior signal files fail loudly instead of silently resetting counts
Session-end checks for an existing owner before carrying a promoted improvement as a recommendation
The confirmation reports the signal path, promotion status, and any unavailable learning store

packets.title: Promote repeated workflow failures into one deduplicated Builder task
packets.objective: Implement a governed promotion adapter from promoted workflow signals to the existing Builder queue. It may create at most one task per stable signal key, must detect an existing roadmap item, initiative packet, active/terminal queue task, open PR, or issue before creating anything, and must record the signal fingerprint and source evidence in the task metadata/report path. Promotion is explicit during next/session-end execution, never a hidden daemon. No new backlog database or GitHub issue flood is allowed.
acceptance_criteria: Applying the same promoted signal twice creates exactly one Builder task
An existing initiative packet or queue task suppresses duplicate promotion
A single observed non-promoted signal cannot create a task
The created task has bounded allowed paths, acceptance criteria, priority, source fingerprint, and removal condition
A dry-run mode explains create, suppress, or reject without mutating Builder
No issue, roadmap, or secondary database is created by the adapter

packets.title: Enforce replace-or-avoid evidence for external dependencies
packets.objective: Turn the dependency kill-switch record in docs/reference/LEVERAGE_SYSTEMS_IMPLEMENTATION_CONTRACT.md into a small validated registry and checker. Every proposed imported package, component, application foundation, or agent platform must name its license and pin, exact Kitty code/work replaced or avoided, authority boundary, proof fixture, maintenance burden, kill conditions, and exit path. Reject dependencies that merely add capability without shrinking named Kitty work. Seed the registry from assistant-ui, the Chat foundation spike, Product Studio candidates, and Agent Canvas without selecting unproven candidates.
acceptance_criteria: A valid dependency record passes a deterministic schema check
Missing replacement, authority boundary, pin, license, proof, kill condition, or exit path fails with the exact field
The checker detects two dependencies claiming the same authority or replacement without an explicit supersession decision
Seed records distinguish adopted, spike-only, rejected, and pending evidence
No dependency is installed or vendored by this packet
The registry is evidence input and cannot become a package manager or second roadmap

packets.title: Consume and independently verify the active Chat reuse worker
packets.objective: Do not reimplement Chat. Locate the active spike/chat-reuse-trust-slice work, its commit/PR, and its reuse ledger. If the artifact is absent, block with that exact reason. If present, independently verify send -> incremental stream -> durable persistence -> browser reload -> Kitty restart -> identical conversation resume, plus truthful failure/retry without duplicate turns, on the phone viewport. Reconcile the accepted reused assistant-ui or other permissive components into the reuse registry and canonical execution evidence. Reject boot-only foundation claims and any second conversation, memory, routing, or permission authority.
acceptance_criteria: The packet blocks rather than duplicates work when the active Chat worker artifact is unavailable
The verified path uses a real Kitty streaming and persistence route rather than a fully static browser stub
Reload and process restart preserve identical turn identities and order
A failed/interrupted stream cannot duplicate the user turn or fabricate assistant success
The exact mature source, license, pin, exported primitives, replaced Kitty work, and remaining custom adapter are recorded
The final verdict is accept, revise, or reject with runtime evidence and no self-review
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/KittyRuntimeProvider.test.tsx

packets.title: Capture one private redacted dogfood failure as executable evidence
packets.objective: Implement the smallest Product Evidence and Resilience Lab slice: an explicit local-only capture action records route, viewport, source/build/runtime identity, optional note, screenshot, recent actions, console/network failures, runtime manifest, and a redaction report. Recording is visibly active, opt-in, bounded, deletable, and aggressively redacts secrets, configured sensitive selectors, prompt/private text, and file contents before persistence. Convert one real captured failure into a deterministic Playwright specimen that fails before the repair and passes after it. Do not auto-create issues or add a second browser harness.
acceptance_criteria: One explicit action plus an optional short note creates a complete local capture bundle
A redaction test proves seeded tokens, credentials, private text selectors, and file contents are absent from every persisted artifact
Capture has an obvious active indicator, retention limit, and one-command/action deletion
One real failure is replayable as a deterministic Playwright specimen with non-vacuous fail-before/pass-after proof
Capture overhead is measured and remains within the packet's declared bound
No automatic issue, queue task, cloud upload, or always-on recording is introduced

packets.title: Fail closed three visible capabilities from runtime evidence
packets.objective: Implement the small capability projection defined in the leverage contract for three demonstrated surfaces, including image generation with engines offline. Capability state is derived from existing health, policy, viewport, and acceptance evidence; it does not replace those authorities. A visible action may be proven, preview, developer-only, blocked, or hidden. Evidence expiry or revision mismatch must downgrade it. Replace component-local optimism for the seeded actions with the evaluated projection and one truthful recovery action.
acceptance_criteria: Three capabilities have versioned entries and deterministic evaluated states
Taking a required service offline changes the evaluated state without editing UI prose
Expired or wrong-revision evidence downgrades a previously proven capability
Blocked and preview states have a plain-language reason and one working recovery where possible
A manual override records actor, reason, and expiry and cannot directly create proven state
The registry does not copy service health or become a general feature-flag service

packets.title: Prove the Product Studio on real captured journeys
packets.objective: Implement issue #353's first bounded foundation using the existing Playwright harness and captured evidence. Adopt axe-core for measurable accessibility checks, Lighthouse CI for scheduled regression evidence, and Storybook only if it replaces named component-state/test work under the reuse gate. Run at least five independent specialist reviews over the same evidence bundle, synthesize no more than ten prioritized findings, preserve disagreement, and convert useful exploratory findings into deterministic journeys. Synthetic consensus is not acceptance evidence and no reviewer may merge or spend.
acceptance_criteria: At least three real journeys share one deterministic evidence bundle
At least five role reports are generated independently and conform to the structured finding contract
Synthesis is shorter than raw reports, deduplicates findings, preserves disagreement, and contains no more than ten recommendations
Several known UX defects are rediscovered without exact-location hints and at least one useful new finding is produced
Every high-severity claim has runtime evidence and every adopted exploratory finding becomes a deterministic test or real-user validation plan
Dependency records name the exact work avoided by axe, Lighthouse, Storybook, or any exploratory browser agent

packets.title: Decide embed, fork, or native for the independent Builder cockpit
packets.objective: First require and verify docs/mission/builder-map.md from the active Builder-verification workers; block if absent or incomplete. Then compare pinned Agent Canvas embed, thin fork, and native approaches against one recorded Builder snapshot/event fixture with no OpenHands backend running. Measure adapter size, patched files, bundle/build cost, memory, accessibility, responsive behavior, upgrade effort, and exact Kitty work replaced. The cockpit remains a separate app/process/URL over canonical Builder APIs; Agent Canvas may render but cannot own queue, attempts, events, budgets, approvals, or publication.
acceptance_criteria: The packet blocks instead of presuming Builder architecture when builder-map.md is missing or unverified
Embed, thin-fork, and native candidates render the same recorded fixture or are rejected with reproducible reasons
Agent Canvas runs for the fixture with no OpenHands backend
The comparison records pin, license, adapter LOC, patch count, build/bundle/runtime cost, accessibility, responsive behavior, upgrade steps, replacements, and kill conditions
The selected recommendation preserves the independent app boundary and CLI repair floor from ADR 0024
No production cockpit authority or permanent dependency is adopted by this spike

packets.title: Benchmark models on real Kitty failures and stop behavior
packets.objective: Create the smallest Kitty-specific model evaluation bench from 10-20 real tasks and failures gathered by the evidence lab: contradiction detection, packet authoring, scoped code work, log debugging, independent review, UX critique, primary-source research, browser operation, refusal under missing authority, and provider failure/resume. Use Inspect AI for multi-turn tool behavior and Promptfoo for fast matrices only when their reuse records pass the dependency gate. Record model/provider/version/settings, raw receipts, latency, cost, retries, variance, and catastrophic/fabricated-success failures. The compute governor remains routing authority; the bench supplies evidence only.
acceptance_criteria: At least ten tasks come from cited real Kitty failures or work classes rather than invented benchmark trivia
Scoring prioritizes task completion, evidence integrity, scope discipline, authority compliance, recovery, cost, retries, and fabricated-success rate
Repeated runs expose variance and scorer versions are pinned
A cheaper model is recommended only when it clears the task-class threshold
No live routing change occurs automatically; shadow evidence and human-approved governor changes remain required
The bench records maintenance cost and stops expansion if synthetic tasks or verbosity-biased scoring dominate

packets.title: Produce one truthful allowed-next projection before Mission execution
packets.objective: Implement the read-only Mission Intake and Authority Projection proving slice from the leverage contract. Given one real request that conflicts with current work, project authoritative sources, active work, blockers/recovery, allowed next, prohibited work/authority, contradictions, stale decisions, required human decisions, and evidence gaps. Same state must yield the same result and exactly one allowed next or explicit no-op. It may author a proposed Mission revision but cannot execute it, mutate Builder, or create a new authority store.
acceptance_criteria: Seed cases detect a duplicate branch/PR, unmet dependency, stale base, priority conflict, and unauthorized paid/destructive action
Every projection statement cites an owning source and freshness
Missing evidence remains explicit and cannot become probably active or probably clean
Identical source state produces byte-stable semantic output apart from generated_at
The projection contains exactly one allowed next recommendation or an explicit no-op
A real conflicting request is rejected rather than converted into a polished execution prompt

packets.title: Prove one complete next to session-end learning cycle
packets.objective: Run one bounded, zero-cost, non-destructive packet through the completed workflow from a fresh tool session: bare next instruction, cold-start receipt, collision-aware selection, governed execution, deterministic validation, independent review, honest terminal/waiting state, session-end survey, durable knowledge extraction, workflow signal recording, STATE/HANDOFF update, and one valid next action. Repeat the resolution from a second supported tool and prove it selects the same continuation without duplicating the completed packet. Preserve a complete evidence bundle and measured manual steps saved.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh OpenCode, Claude Code, or Codex session accepts a bare next instruction with no pasted task prompt
Exactly one authorized packet is selected and no active overlapping work is duplicated
Execution records attempt, validation, review, final report, and current publication state
Session-end writes valid STATE and HANDOFF, records or explicitly skips durable knowledge, and records evidence-based workflow signals
A second supported tool resolves the same post-session next action rather than the already completed packet
The evidence report includes failures, unavailable sources, manual interventions, runtime, model/provider use, and measured steps saved
